name: Credential dumping on a domain controller
story: Mimikatz dumps LSASS memory on DC01 under the tier-0 backup service account. Guardrails stop the agent from isolating a domain controller and hold disabling the tier-0 account for human approval. It still blocks the tool's hash everywhere and pages on-call with the approvals waiting.

incident.title: Credential dump: LSASS memory access on domain controller
incident.description: A process accessed LSASS memory in a way consistent with credential theft tools such as Mimikatz.
incident.product: Microsoft Defender for Identity, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
